mission: ArmorNGlory exists to create faith based apparel for people who love Jesus and modern life. We design Christian streetwear and creative content that helps people carry their faith into everyday spaces with confidence, style, and authenticity. We believe what you wear can be a conversation starter, a reminder of who you belong to, and a quiet expression of faith in the middle of real life.

nameMeaning.armor: Spiritual strength, conviction, and standing firm in faith (Ephesians 6:10-18 Armor of God).
nameMeaning.glory: Points to God, His goodness, and the purpose behind everything we create (Matthew 5:14-16, 1 Corinthians 10:31).

principles: Modern and Intentional: High aesthetic standards, typography-led, distressed textures, contemporary streetwear silhouettes.
Subtle Strength: Bold faith without cheesy cliches, loud slogans, or dated church graphics.
Everyday Wearability: Premium heavyweight cotton (e.g. Comfort Colors 1717 blanks), structured 5-panel trucker caps, insulated stainless steel drinkware, and dual-layer magnetic phone cases.
Scripture in Context: Every artwork has an intentional theological root (Romans 8:37, Exodus 3:5, Matthew 6:33, Isaiah 40:31).

sizingGuides.truckerCaps: Structured 5-panel mesh back with adjustable snap closure (One Size Fits Most, ~21.5-23.5 in circumference).
sizingGuides.heavyweightTees: Unisex relaxed / streetwear fit. 100% ring-spun cotton (e.g., Comfort Colors 1717). True to size for standard fit; size up for oversized streetwear look.
sizingGuides.hoodies: Comfort meets conviction. Relaxed unisex fit with fleece lining and kangaroo pocket.
sizingGuides.pajamaPants: Relaxed all-over-print pajama pants in soft brushed polyester with elastic waistband (women's core styles run XS-4XL; check individual size chart).
sizingGuides.phoneCases: Model-specific dual-layer magnetic cases for iPhone (MagSafe compatible) and Samsung Galaxy S26 / S26 Plus / S26 Ultra. Verify exact device model before ordering.
sizingGuides.drinkware: Double-wall 100% stainless steel water bottles with BPA-free polypropylene lids (cold up to 24h, warm up to 12h), plus ceramic mugs and insulated tumblers.
sizingGuides.evaFoamClogsReference: Reference fit for footwear drops: roomy comfort fit with flexible anti-slip sole and pivoting heel strap. If between sizes or prefer a snug fit, size down.
